narrative: On the board. A single fair-copied leaf on the desk, no heading above the verse, the March scrap set aside with a line through nothing on it. The light is the last of the evening. On the board. The foot of the same leaf. One word in the last line is written where an easier word would have asked for the kiss. No name in the margin. No number.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the leaf and did not add a name.

entities.name: the keyboard sonnet
entities.context: Shown on draft in The word that does not pardon him
